name: medex
description: Scripts to run the client and server together. Not a workspace; each package (server, client, shared) keeps its own dependencies.

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.test: npm test --prefix shared && npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
